posts.title: Me Neither
posts.description: Yesterday after class, I went to switch my internet provider. After that, I didn’t really want to go straight home. I didn’t want to go too far either. posts.title: It’s been a while since winter
posts.description: It’s been a while since I last walked into an indie cinema. A while, too, since I last gave myself over to the purity of art. Lately, I’ve felt that something has been missing from my life. Something soulful, maybe. Something that once felt quietly, unmistakably mine.
